data.one_liner: A Flutter map library for interactive and customizable maps from shape files or tile services.
data.what_it_does: A data visualization library that renders interactive maps from GeoJSON shape files or tile providers like OpenStreetMap, Mapbox, and Google Maps. It supports markers, bubbles, legends, tooltips, sublayers, and zooming and panning.
use_when: You need to display geographical data using custom shape files or GeoJSON.
You require tile layer rendering from providers like OpenStreetMap or Mapbox.
You need map elements such as bubbles, markers, legends, and tooltips.
avoid_when: You cannot acquire a Syncfusion commercial or community license.
You only need basic native Google Maps view without custom shape visualization or complex data layers.
strengths: Rich feature set including shape layers, tile layers, bubbles, markers, and vector layers.
Supports zooming, panning, color mapping, and custom tooltips.
Compatible with multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
weaknesses: Commercial package requiring a Syncfusion license.
data.setup_notes: Requires either a commercial Syncfusion license or a Free Syncfusion Community license. GeoJSON shape files must be added to assets if used.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is an open-source, highly customizable mapping package based on Leaflet for Flutter.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you specifically need native Google Maps integration across Android and iOS.
